# FindALocalPro — Full Reference

> Verified home service professionals in DuPage County, Illinois.
> Last updated: 2026-02-20

## About

FindALocalPro is a home services verification platform serving DuPage County, IL. We check every contractor against 4 government databases before they appear on our site. No paid placements, no ads — just verified credentials.

Founded: 2026
Location: Downers Grove, IL
Phone: (630) 703-2607
Website: https://findalocalpro.com

## Verification Process — Detailed

### Database 1: IDFPR (Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation)
- What we check: Active state license status for regulated trades (plumbing, electrical, roofing)
- What it means: The pro passed state licensing exams and meets education/experience requirements
- Disqualification: Expired, revoked, or suspended license
- Source: idfpr.illinois.gov public license lookup

### Database 2: IL Secretary of State — Business Registration
- What we check: Business entity registration and good standing status
- What it means: The company is a real, registered Illinois business — not a fly-by-night operation
- Disqualification: Dissolved, revoked, or "not in good standing" status
- Source: Cyber Drive Illinois business search

### Database 3: Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- What we check: BBB rating (A+ through F), complaint volume, complaint resolution patterns
- What it means: Shows how the business handles disputes and customer complaints
- Disqualification: F rating
- Source: bbb.org/chicago

### Database 4: BuildZoom
- What we check: Building permit history, contractor ranking score
- What it means: Verified track record of permitted work in the area
- No hard disqualification, but factored into Trust Score
- Source: buildzoom.com

### Re-verification
All providers are re-verified monthly. If a license expires or a business is dissolved between verification cycles, the provider is flagged and removed from active listings.

## Trust Score Calculation

Each provider receives a Trust Score from 0-100:

| Component | Weight | Scoring |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| License (IDFPR) | 40% | Active = full points, expired = 0 |
| Business Registration (SOS) | 25% | Active/good standing = full points |
| BBB Rating | 15% | A+ = 15, A = 13, B = 10, C = 7, F = 0 |
| BuildZoom Score | 10% | Normalized from BZ ranking |
| Customer Reviews | 10% | 4.5+ stars = 10, 4.0+ = 7, 3.5+ = 4, <3.5 = 1 |

Zero reviews = no penalty (score scales to 100 without review weight).
1-2 reviews = half weight. 3+ reviews = full weight.
